column2: Sterile Laryngeal Mask Airway PVC
column3: Product Info The Sterile Laryngeal Mask Airway (LMA) – Size 1 is a single-use airway device made from high-quality, medical-grade PVC, engineered specifically for neonates and infants weighing up to 5 kg. It is ideal for use during pediatric anesthesia, resuscitation, and short surgical procedures, offering a less invasive alternative to endotracheal intubation. Designed with a smooth, anatomically curved airway tube and a soft inflatable cuff, this LMA ensures a snug seal around the laryngeal inlet while minimizing trauma to delicate tissues. Its EO sterilization and individually sealed packaging ensure maximum hygiene and patient safety. With a universal 15 mm connector, it seamlessly integrates with most anesthesia and ventilation systems, making it an essential device in NICUs, pediatric ICUs, ambulances, and emergency medical settings. Key Features Size : 1 – Suitable for neonates and small infants (0–5 kg) Material : Medical-grade PVC – soft, flexible, and latex-free Sterile & Disposable : EO sterilized, individually packed for one-time use Inflatable Cuff : Provides a secure and leak-resistant seal Anatomical Design : Easy, trauma-free insertion Universal Connector : 15 mm standard fit for anesthesia and ventilator systems Safe & Practical : Minimizes risk of cross-contamination with single-use design

column2: Formalin Chamber Transparent Acrylic Disinfection Box Trays Surgical Instrument Sterilization
